rationale: Price has surged roughly $5 in the last two 1-minute candles on heavy volume, placing it at the absolute top of today's range (100th percentile) and well above VWAP ($66.67) and the 9-EMA ($65.89). Entering long here chases an already-extended move with a wide bid-ask spread (60.5 bps) and no consolidation, while a short against a strong momentum spike with no sign of reversal is equally unattractive. The risk/reward in either direction is unfavorable at this moment; waiting for price to either consolidate or show a clear reversal signal is the prudent course.
